text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The news that Symboli Rudolf had moved to a backstage role
sent shockwaves through the world.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I'm so shocked!
To think I won't get to see Rudolf race ever again!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text: I wonder if there's any Umamusume who could ever replace Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Many voices lamented Symboli Rudolf stepping away from the front lines. One day—

text_block_list.name: Text from Sirius
text_block_list.text: "Come here today at 13:00."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I received an email summoning me
from Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The reason I asked you all to gather today... is to solicit your opinions regarding Sirius's plan to take on overseas challenges.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"You'll understand if you just listen.
Be a good girl."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —It's an extended overseas expedition spanning two whole years, with a plan that ultimately sets sights on taking on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: URA Official with Black Glasses
text_block_list.text: T-Two whole years...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: When I consulted the person in charge of the 'Overseas Expedition Program'—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The response was that while they wish to consider it positively, they would first like to confirm the intentions of all parties involved.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In regards to this, I would first like to
ask for your candid opinion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Man
text_block_list.text:
...We are, of course, in favor. Japan is
falling behind the rest of the world. In that
sense as well, we strongly encourage you to take on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Please wait. This is a major project
that pours in a huge amount of budget and effort, you know?

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
We've had a similar conversation before, but
Sirius-san has only just finished her Classic tier.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Even considering all factors...
I can hardly say they are the right person for the job.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The meeting gradually grew contentious between those who opposed and supported Sirius Symboli's overseas challenge—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Man
text_block_list.text:
Talk of Rudolf taking on an overseas challenge
came up right after her Classic year, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
"Well, Symboli Rudolf-san is,
um... quite an exceptional case, so—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"First of all, what defines 'the right person'? What is the goal of the 'Overseas Expedition Program'?
The topic drifted off track, and things spun out of control—"

text_block_list.name: URA Official with Black Glasses
text_block_list.text: First of all, aren't you Umamusume getting a bit ahead of yourselves here...?!

text_block_list.name: URA Official with Black Glasses
text_block_list.text:
As for stepping into a backstage role, Symboli Rudolf-san,
to be honest, we wished you had consulted with us beforehand...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...At any rate, it seems we currently lack sufficient information to make a judgment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will rework the detailed materials on my end.
Let us reschedule this meeting for another day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Symboli Rudolf was somehow managing
to wrap up the meeting—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Agh, what a pain in the neck!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Lightning struck.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
We don't need no extra handouts.
Right, ladies and gents gathered here today?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I get what you're trying to say.
And I understand."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Overseas ain't a walk in the park.
I knew from the start I wasn't good enough yet.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I told you I wanted to hear your opinion first with that in mind—so you're saying we haven't even reached that stage yet, huh.

text_block_list.name: URA Official with Black Glasses
text_block_list.text:
...This opinion is strictly based on the risks.
I'm not blaming you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ――Just watch me for one year.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll shut you up with sheer power.
I'm gonna rewrite those brains of yours.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That the only 'Emperor' to sit upon the throne
would be Sirius Symboli—and no other.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Do that, and you'll nod like a good child, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps sensing her overwhelming presence—
the room fell dead silent, and before long, the curtains drew to a close.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...She was the one who brought it up. Asking if I had any interest in taking on a long-term challenge abroad.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Examples of overseas campaigns are rare.
Even more so when it spans two years.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Won't you become a precedent—a monumental milestone,
and illuminate the path for those who follow?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If a path is made, they too can move forward.
There will be no need to kill their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I have zero interest in what she's plotting.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Preaching the path is a saint's job.
If you can't carve it out yourself, that's where you end.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Be that as it may,
I figured a two-year overseas expedition wasn't a bad deal."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...You probably realized it today yourself, but
overseas expeditions aren't soft. In every sense of the word.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"To make your name echo across skies no one has ever reached,
you must first earn the acknowledgment of those around you."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Winning is a given.
On top of that, we turn it into funding.
Even better if we land sponsors.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, follow my lead for a year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her eyes sparkle in the evening glow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...As she ran through the Classic year,
she almost lost sight of her dream once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It had grown even stronger
than the light felt after the Arima Kinen.
choice_data_list: As I thought, you truly are the star that should shine the brightest.
As I thought, you truly are the star that should shine the brightest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Surely, it will never
lose that light again."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Shut up, you don't have to keep repeating yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next target race is the Osaka Hai.
I want to leave an unforgettable mark...!
